task.title: Maintain the documentation-assistant boundary in BPM 0.9.4
task.shortdesc: Keep the released localized training notice and deterministic-search boundary accurate while maintaining BPM documentation.

prereq.p: Have the approved BPM source revision and documentation publication workflow available.

context.p: There is no local model, model artifact, RAG generation, embedding store, citation store, or external-source provider to maintain in 0.9.4. Do not create maintenance state for features that this release does not deliver.

step.cmd: Apply the approved BPM source revision and rebuild the documentation.

info.p: Use the normal documentation workflow, including make docs-install-dev when preparing a development checkout.

step.cmd: Open the published documentation in every supported locale.

info.p: Confirm that the assistant entry remains available and that deterministic search still works independently.

step.cmd: Submit one question in each locale.

info.p: Verify the locale-owned training notice and confirm that no answer, source, citation, external claim, or model-installation flow is presented.

step.cmd: Do not run model-installation or RAG-generation commands for 0.9.4.

info.p: They belong to a later product release and are not a recovery path for the training notice.

step.cmd: Record the documentation revision and verification result.

info.p: Escalate a mismatch between the released notice and the deterministic-search boundary as a documentation defect.

result.p: The published portal preserves a localized training notice for the chat and a separate current-information path through deterministic search.

postreq.p: Do not retain user questions as a maintenance artifact. Reassess model and retrieval operations only when a later release explicitly delivers them.
